posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
here is my basic idea on how to build the pages quickly.
and relative easy to check.
however, this may require 5 global switches too (red, green, white etc)
Code:
if: $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[4]) && !gameSwitches.value(4)
item 4 = -1
control switches 4 = ON
activate page 1 (selfSwitch A)
else
if: $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[5]) && !gameSwitch.value(5)
item 5 = -1
control switches 5 = ON
activate page 2 (selfSwitch B)
and continue like this.
however, you only have selfSwitch A, B, C, D,  and I have a plugin to add custom
switch name, so activate the page, instead of the ABCD found [
here
].
each page has its own sprite (blue, white, green, yellow, red orbs).
as long the switch is OFF globally, this one isn't activated.
keep in mind, that each event can be equal, as they can't be activated with the same,
because the global switch is checked, if true and you have a duplicate item,
this will fail, so if false, and you have the item, your good to go.
this is only a basic (2 conditions).
you can also just end the condition and a new one below it (same effect).
it depends which one is more comfortable for you.

posts.body:
if you do add choices on top of the condition => if yes (nothing happens)
as it continue whatever is below it.
if no => Exit Event Processing (which abort the event) or
jump to label: exit
below the conditions:
label: exit
Text:
I need to find the tablet for this one.
(or any text or no text at all to stop the event)
there are many ways.
the one I showed with nested condition can any orb be placed,
you can also keep it to just 1, and use an else handler to find the orb/tablet.
specially if it has only 1 spot to be placed (which is mostly cleaner).
this avoid multiple condition or nested conditions.
